response.answer: CAPiTA Miles Fallon Pro (Navigator 158 Miles Fallon LTD) — Comprehensive Product Research IDENTIFICATION & PROVENANCE 1. Brand: CAPiTA (also stylized as Capita) [1] 2. Model name: Navigator 158 Miles Fallon LTD [2] 3. Also referred to as: CAPiTA Miles Fallon Pro [3] 4. Base model name: The Navigator [4] 5. Model year: 2025/2026 season (listed as "2026" by some retailers, "2025" by others — CAPiTA uses a split-season naming convention) [5] 6. Product type: Men's snowboard [6] 7. Board category: Powder / Resort / Freeride [7] 8. Limited edition: Yes — released to celebrate Miles Fallon's elevation to the CAPiTA Pro Team [8] 9. Pro model rider: Miles Fallon [9] 10. Miles Fallon age: 24 years old at time of pro model release [10] 11. Miles Fallon background: Has been with CAPiTA since age 12, raised riding in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and the Mid-Atlantic [11] 12. Custom artwork: By Arthur Longo — collaboration between two CAPiTA team riders [12] 13. Available size (LTD version): 158 cm only [13] 14. Release date: December 8, 2025 [14] 15. Pro announcement event: At evo Seattle, at the premiere of CAPiTA team movie "Float" [15] 16. Manufacturer: CAPiTA Snowboards (operated by C3 Worldwide LLC, 4917 14th Ave NW, Seattle, WA 98107 USA; manufacturing by Core S.r.l., Italy) [16] 17. Manufacturing location: The MotherShip™, Feistritz an der Gail, Carinthia, Austria [17] 18. CAPiTA founded: Seattle, 2000 [18] 19. B Corp certified: Yes — B Impact Score of 98.9, significantly exceeding median of 50.9 [19] 20. Clean energy manufacturing: 100% clean energy powered facility — hydro-activated NH3 Thermal Energy System + solar panels [20] 21. NFC technology: All boards since 2020 include NFC chip for production tracking and board registration [21] 22. Warranty: 2-year manufacturer warranty from date of original purchase [22] PRICING & AVAILABILITY 23. MSRP (USD) — Miles Fallon LTD: $649.95 [23] 24. Price (AUD) — Melbourne Snowboard Centre: AUD $1,099.99 (merchant verified) [24] 25. Price (EUR) — Behind The Pines (Amsterdam): €619.95 (sold out) [25] 26. Standard Navigator MSRP (USD, non-LTD): $519.96 at evo / REI / Blauer Board Shop [26] 27. Standard Navigator price at Sun & Ski Sports: $419.83 (discounted) [27] 28. Navigator available at (US): evo, REI, Amazon (CAPiTA's store), Buckmans, Blauer Board Shop, The House, Sun & Ski Sports [28] 29. Miles Fallon LTD available at: capitasnowboarding.com (direct), Buckmans, Balmoral Boards (AU), Melbourne Snowboard Centre (AU), Behind The Pines (EU), World Boards [29] 30. Stock status (CAPiTA direct): Low stock ("Low stock: left") [30] 31. Stock status (Behind The Pines): Sold out [31] 32. SnowboardingProfiles price listed for standard Navigator: $649 [32] 33. Standard Navigator price above average: $51.95 more than average snowboard price of $468.01 [33] SHAPE & DESIGN 34. Shape: Directional with 0.8 inch (2.0 cm) setback [34] 35. Sidecut type: Parabolic Radical Taper [35] 36. Sidecut description: Mirror-symmetrical curve creating deeper sidecut and quicker turning point in centre compared to radial arcs [36] 37. Sidecut radius (158 cm): 8.1 / 7.0 / 8.1 m [37] 38. Taper (158 cm): 12 mm [38] 39. Nose/tail width (158 cm): 30.5 / 29.3 cm [39] 40. Waist width (158 cm): 25.6 cm [40] 41. Effective edge (158 cm): 1192 mm (per CAPiTA official page) [41] 42. DISAGREEMENT — Effective edge (158 cm): Merchant lists 119.5 cm (1195 mm); CAPiTA official page lists 1192 mm. Comment: 3 mm discrepancy; manufacturer source likely more authoritative. [41][42] 43. Reference stance (158 cm): 55.9 cm / 22 inches [43] 44. Suggested weight (158 cm): 150–200 lbs / 68–91 kg (CAPiTA official) [44] 45. Suggested boot size (158 cm): US Men 8–10 / EU 41–43 [45] 46. Nose design: Wide-frame rockered nose for maximum float in soft conditions [46] 47. Tail design: Tapered sinking tail that helps swim effortlessly through deep snow [47] CAMBER & PROFILE 48. Camber type: Resort V2 Directional + Flat Kick Tech [48] 49. Camber description: Raised camber platform through the inserts for high-speed edge hold, elevated contact points to land and float in powder, Flat Kick tip and tail arcs for faster aggressive transitions [49] FLEX 50. Flex rating (CAPiTA official / Miles Fallon LTD): Directional 5.5 [50] 51. DISAGREEMENT — Flex rating: Merchant source lists 6/10; CAPiTA official and Behind The Pines list 5.5/10. Comment: The merchant (Melbourne Snowboard Centre) may be describing the standard Navigator differently; the manufacturer's LTD page explicitly states 5.5. [50][51] 52. Flex feel on snow (reviewer tested): Medium (6/10) — felt slightly over medium between feet [52] 53. Nose flex (reviewer measured): 4.5/10 — noticeably softer and more pressable [53] 54. Tail flex (reviewer measured): 6.5/10 — slightly stiffer, requires some muscle to tail press [54] 55. Torsional flex (reviewer measured): 5.5/10 — consistent toe to heel [55] 56. Flex direction: Directional [56] 57. On-snow flex feel (The Good Ride): Med/Stiff between the feet, pretty easy flex in the nose, stiffer off the tail [57] CONSTRUCTION 58. Core: Hover Core™ — Paulownia/Poplar blend, ultralight, strong, excellent dampening properties [58] 59. Core wood species: Thin cut low-density Paulownia strips combined with 7mm Poplar beams [59] 60. Reinforcement: 2 x 30 mm Technora™ Flax Boosters — aramid fiber interwoven with all-natural Flax [60] 61. Fiberglass: HolySheet™ Tri/Bi fiberglass — higher glass to weight ratio than standard fibreglass [61] 62. Resin: Magic Bean™ Resin — 60% bio-content from renewable agricultural raw material, produced with no waste or greenhouse emissions [62] 63. Base: Hyperdrive™ Base — sintered, ultra-high molecular weight, ultra-high density polyethylene with special additives [63] 64. Base construction: Die-cut base (may have two base colour variations per size to minimize waste) [64] 65. Topsheet: Skinless™ Core Ash Woodgrain Topsheet — specially treated pure wood veneer, 220g lighter than standard process [65] 66. Topsheet technology: PLT™ Topsheet Technology — exclusive to CAPiTA, bonds topsheet to an already pressed snowboard [66] 67. Sidewall: Full ABS1000 Sidewalls (merchant verified) [67] 68. Edges: 360 Degree HRC48 Steel Edges (merchant verified) [68] 69. Mounting pattern: Stainless Steel 4x2 Inserts (4x4 hole pattern compatible with standard strap bindings) [69] 70. Factory edge bevel: Base Bevel 1.5° / Side Bevel 1.5° / Overall angle geometry 90° [70] SUSTAINABILITY 71. Energy source: 100% clean energy (hydro + solar) — zero CO2 emissions, zero ozone depletion, zero global warming potential [71] 72. Raw materials sourcing: 98% locally sourced (50% Austria, 16% Germany, 15% Slovenia, 14% Switzerland, 3% Italy, 2% Asia) [72] 73. Inks: Water-based, UV-curable, solventless inks [73] 74. Wood cores: FSC certified wood cores [74] 75. Resin bio-content: 60% renewable agricultural raw material [75] 76. Recycling: All production scraps recycled including base materials, tip/tail trimmings, sidewall ABS, wood core milling waste [76] 77. Environmental award: Energy Globe Award for Austria (2017) — known as "Nature's Nobel Prize" [77] PERFORMANCE & RIDE CHARACTERISTICS 78. Riding style: Mellow freeride / powder-focused [78] 79. Terrain focus: Powder, sidecountry, resort, trees, groomers [79] 80. Ride feel: Surfy — makes you want to make wider cruisy-style turns and slash snow mounds [80] 81. Float performance: Excellent — more floaty than other CAPiTA boards like BSOD, but far from Spring Break powder boards [81] 82. Powder performance: Outstanding — board excels in deep snow [82] 83. Groomer performance: Surprisingly good — Navigator is a decent all-mountain board even without powder [83] 84. Edge hold on ice: Only "okay" — back foot tends to slip out of turns in very slippery conditions [84] 85. Hardpack performance: Mediocre — performs well enough to get by, but not recommended for frequent ice riders [85] 86. Uneven snow: Bucks and bounces in uneven snow — a noted weakness [86] 87. Pop/ollie: Pretty stable, poppy overall ride [87] 88. Tree riding: Particularly good — light weight and manoeuvrability make it excellent in tight spaces [88] 89. Dampening: Technora Flax Boosters reduce chatter and increase stability at high speeds [89] 90. Base glide: Excellent — CAPiTA is doing good things with their bases, very good glide [90] 91. Weight feel (on snow): Felt light [91] 92. Playfulness: Nose is playful feeling; allows you to charge while still pressing or nose buttering [92] 93. Rider fatigue: Taper and sinking tail reduce rider fatigue during longer powder days [93] 94. Durability concern (forum): Construction not as burly as some — will get beat up if used as daily driver [94] REVIEWS & RATINGS 95. SnowboardingProfiles rating: 90.0/100 — ranked 2nd out of 30 mellow freeride snowboards tested [95] 96. Board of the World rating: 80.35/100 (4.0/5) [96] 97. SnowboardingProfiles classification: Mellow Freeride [97] 98. Board of the World ranking: 38th out of 38 in all-mountain category (Note: this ranks it low as an all-mountain board because it's really a powder specialist being judged on hardpack criteria) [98] 99. Board of the World value assessment: "Excellent Value: Premium, durable construction at a budget-friendly price for a pow all-mountain board" [99] 100. SnowboardingProfiles best suited rider: Someone looking for a directional board good in powder that handles groomers, doesn't want stiff aggressive ride, wants easy maneuverability [100] 101. Ability level: Intermediate to advanced — not for beginners [101] 102. Forum user experience (SnowboardingForum): "It's a FUN pow board. Its very light and floats like a dream" [102] 103. Forum user experience (SnowboardingForum): "tons of fun to carve and slash around on" [103] STANDARD NAVIGATOR — SIZE RANGE & SPECS (for reference) 104. Available sizes (standard Navigator): 143 cm, 147 cm, 155 cm, 158 cm, 161 cm, 164 cm, 167 cm [104] 105. Available sizes (Miles Fallon LTD version — merchant listing): 155, 158, 161, 164, 167 cm (merchant verified attribute) [105] 106. DISAGREEMENT — Available sizes (LTD version): CAPiTA official site lists only 158 cm for the Miles Fallon LTD; merchant site lists 155–167 cm range. Comment: The official site clearly names it "Navigator 158 Miles Fallon LTD" — the merchant may be listing the standard Navigator sizes alongside the LTD. The LTD appears to be 158 cm only. [106][107] 107. Reference stance 155 cm: 53.3 cm (merchant verified) [108] 108. Reference stance 161 cm: 58.4 cm (merchant verified) [109] COMPARISONS & COMPETITORS 109. Comparable boards (powder/freeride): Jones Storm Chaser, Lib Tech Orca, Jones Mind Expander, Burton Deep Thinker, Ride Warpig, Bataleon Surfer [110] 110. Navigator vs Jones Storm Chaser: Storm Chaser is more volume-shifted (short/wide), more surf-inspired, better for dedicated deep powder; Navigator is more versatile on groomers [111] 111. Navigator vs Jones Dreamweaver: Navigator slightly better in powder; Dreamweaver slightly better on hard/icy snow [112] 112. Within CAPiTA lineup — powder float ranking: Navigator > BSOD > Mercury, but Navigator << Spring Break powder boards [113] 113. Navigator vs CAPiTA Mercury: Mercury is better for hard snow/ice and more versatile all-mountain; Navigator is the powder specialist [114] 114. SnowboardingProfiles "mellow freeride" top list: Navigator ranked #2 overall [115] 115. The Good Ride assessment: "a great powder board for those looking to quiver up on a budget" [116] 116. Navigator series first year in lineup: 2018 (now in approximately 7th year of production as of 2025) [117] MANUFACTURER REPUTATION 117. CAPiTA brand reputation: One of the leading manufacturers in the snowboard industry [118] 118. Manufacturing philosophy: Full in-house production with localized supply chain [119] 119. CAPiTA on-site testing: Factory has snowboard slope with chairlift for prototype testing [120] 120. evo reputation: Major specialty retailer; price match + 5% guarantee, up to 1-year returns, 10% rewards [121] 121. REI reputation: Major outdoor retailer; member rewards program, established for decades [122] 122. Melbourne Snowboard Centre: Independent Australian snowboard shop; 30-day return for store credit/exchange, no change-of-mind refunds [123] 123. Behind The Pines: Amsterdam-based specialty retailer; 4.9 Google Reviews rating, 30-day return period [124] 2025 NAVIGATOR UPDATES (applicable to LTD) 124. 2025 base upgrade: New HyperDrive™ high-speed sintered base (upgrade from PowerDrive base on earlier models) [125] 125. 2024 camber profile change: Resort V2 Directional profile introduced, making board more forgiving than previous years at expense of some spring out of turn [126]
